text: time window read: 2025-05-01 00:00:00 to 2025-06-01 00:00:00 (end excluded) (WINDOW_START / WINDOW_END in .env; empty = all data); flare thresholds, reference period and all limits are computed inside this window only

duplicate tag names (spaces and case ignored) keep the first copy in folder order flare_data > DAK > DIU > ISOM > ISOM_3 > LOUP > PDA > PG > SEU1 > SEU2 > SEU3; flare folder first so a flare tag is always marked is_flare
all tags resampled to the most common file sampling interval 0 days 00:01:00 (bin mean), as in pca_pc_t2
flaring = any flare tag > median + 3 * MAD (MAD x 1.4826), flags <= 5 samples apart merged into one event (pca_pc_t2 s0_audit rule)
reference = rows before 2025-05-19 14:23:24 (first 60% of time), flare windows NOT excluded
combined matrix has 273 tags = 270 process + 3 flare (prompt expected about 376: all tags -103, process tags only -106)
PCA fit rows = the full cleaned matrix (44640 rows); each process tag standardized over these rows (zero mean, unit variance)
PC scores standardized to unit variance (each divided by its std over the fit rows) before Stage 3
flare tags enter PC as standardized in Stage 1 (reference mean / std); PC scores as standardized in Stage 2
PC runs on every 10th row of the node matrix (4464 rows): consecutive samples are strongly autocorrelated, and Fisher-Z uses the data only through the correlation matrix and n
PC depth cap max_k = 3: largest depth <= 3 whose CI-test upper bound (8.17e+04) fits the budget 3e+07
PC: causal-learn pc, Fisher-Z, stable = True, uc_rule = 0, uc_priority = 2, alphas [0.01, 0.05]; flare tags in tier 1 (no edge into tier 0, none within tier 1, so flare-flare edges are forbidden too)

downstream alpha = 0.01: the stricter level of the sweep, as in causal_t2; with thousands of rows Fisher-Z rejects independence for very small correlations, so the stricter level keeps the graph sparser
DAG = Dor-Tarsi consistent extension of the PC CPDAG; flare tags removed first (all edges into flares); bidirected edges treated as undirected; ties broken by the matrix column order
reference period for Σ = Stage 1 'reference' rows (the repo's normal-operation rule)
Σ = correlation matrix of the 26784 reference rows; tags re-standardized with reference mean and std so that Σ is exactly their covariance
per flare event: first out-of-control T² from 0 days 06:00:00 before onset to the event end; nodes ranked by the share of significant |T_j·PA(j)| (then mean |T|) over the 0 days 00:30:00 after it
flagged node = |T_j·PA(j)| > z at the first T² alarm of a flare event (paper Fig. 5 reading); each flagged PC is listed with its top 15 tags by |loading| (tables/flagged_pc_tags.csv)
